problems.readme:
# PKPO 奖励变换与无偏策略梯度

依据 [PKPO v5 Eq. (12)、Eq. (33)](https://arxiv.org/html/2505.15201v5)，实现优化 k 次采样中最佳结果的奖励变换。奖励可为任意有限实数；二值奖励下，期望最大值就是 pass@k。

## 函数

输入浮点张量 `[...,N]`，最后一维是一组独立策略采样，`1<=k<=N`。

1. `maxk_estimate(rewards,k)` 返回 `[...]`，计算所有 k 元子集的最大值平均。奖励升序排列为 `g[0:N]` 后：

$$\widehat M_k=\sum_{j=0}^{N-1}\frac{\binom{j}{k-1}}{\binom Nk}g_j.$$

2. `pkpo_weights(rewards,k)` 返回**已 detach、恢复原采样顺序**的系数：

$$a_i=\frac{1}{\binom Nk}\sum_{I:\ |I|=k,\ i\in I}\left[\max_{j\in I}g_j-\max_{j\in I\setminus\{i\}}g_j\right].$$

`k=1` 明确约定空集合 baseline 为零，即 `a_i=g_i/N`。`k>=2` 可排序后用前缀和，避免枚举子集：

$$a_{(i)}=\sum_{j<i}\frac{\binom{j}{k-2}}{\binom Nk}(g_{(i)}-g_{(j)}).$$

无效组合数为零。奖励相同的差值自然为零，不应给并列最大值随意分配 advantage。最后将系数恢复原始顺序。

3. `pkpo_loss(log_probs,rewards,k)` 返回 `-mean_groups(sum_i(log_probs_i*a_i))`。`log_probs` 与奖励同形，是已采样动作的标量 log probability。系数已包含样本归一化，**不要再对 N 取 mean**。梯度仅经过 log probability。

可复用已提供的参数校验、组合数辅助函数。输入为有限 CPU float32/float64，前置 group 维非空。保留 dtype/device、输入值和非连续布局兼容性；最大值估计允许奖励梯度，策略系数必须 detach。覆盖负奖励、并列、`N=1`、`k=N`、`N=256`，避免整数溢出。

例：`rewards=[.2,.9,.4], k=3` 得到 `[0,.5,0]`。这些是策略梯度系数，不是概率，也不是 GRPO 的组内标准化 advantage。

## 论文原生 toy

复现 §5.1 的设置：`X~Normal(theta,std=.1)`，区间 `[0,1]` 内奖励为 `X²`，否则为零。T3 用你的函数计算 `k=1,4,8` 的期望最大值曲线，以及提交 loss 的实际策略梯度。采用固定 CPU 小预算（2048 组、N=16、15 个均值），独立重算论文 toy，不声称复用论文随机样本或复现 LLM 训练。
problems.notes:
# 题解

Eq. (33) 中，样本只有是所在子集唯一最大值时才有贡献。其排序位置为 i，次大值位置为 j<i，其余 k-2 项有 `C(j,k-2)` 种选法。加权求和即得到前缀公式。对系数和“系数×奖励”分别求累计和，排序后即可算出全部权重。并列项差值为零，恢复原序后结果与并列排序顺序无关。

k=1 使用明确约定的零 baseline，恢复 reward/N 的 REINFORCE；k=N 只保留最大与次大奖励之差，并列最大则全零。k>=2 时统一平移奖励不改变权重。不能直接对变换后的系数做 leave-one-out 均值，因为每个系数已依赖整组样本。

权重已含 `1/C(N,k)`，与 log probability 相乘后沿样本求和，仅对独立组平均。score-function 梯度需要 detach 奖励及采样动作，不能混入 pathwise 梯度。

## 源版本和 toy

题目归于 NeurIPS 2025，固定[修订 v5 Eq. (33)](https://arxiv.org/html/2505.15201v5)，直接从子集定义推导，避开旧版本曾修正的递推式。前缀实现独立编写，并非复制附录代码。Eq. (33) 的空集最大值需要约定，因此显式规定 k=1 零 baseline。不实现 PPO clipping 或完整 LLM 训练器。

Gaussian toy 保留论文标准差和奖励区间，用固定网格展示目标及梯度，不声称训练收敛或模型指标复现。小组 oracle 枚举所有子集；二值策略枚举所有采样批次，将期望梯度与 `k*(1-p)^(k-1)` 比较。四个 mutant 覆盖均值代替最大值目标、未变换奖励、未恢复样本顺序、重复归一化。

en.title: PKPO Reward Transform and Unbiased Policy Gradient
en.readme:
# PKPO Reward Transform and Unbiased Policy Gradient

Implement the reward transform that optimizes the best result among `k` policy samples, following [PKPO v5, Eq. (12) and Eq. (33)](https://arxiv.org/html/2505.15201v5). Rewards can be real numbers; for binary rewards the expected maximum is pass@k.

## Functions

Inputs are floating tensors `[..., N]`, one independent group on the last axis, `1 <= k <= N`.

1. `maxk_estimate(rewards, k)` returns `[...]`. It averages `max(rewards[I])` over all size-k subsets. For ascending sorted rewards `g[0:N]`, it equals

$$\widehat M_k=\sum_{j=0}^{N-1}\frac{\binom{j}{k-1}}{\binom Nk}g_j.$$

2. `pkpo_weights(rewards, k)` returns **detached** coefficients in original sample order:

$$a_i=\frac{1}{\binom Nk}\sum_{I:\ |I|=k,\ i\in I}\left[\max_{j\in I}g_j-\max_{j\in I\setminus\{i\}}g_j\right].$$

For `k=1`, explicitly use `a_i=g_i/N` (zero baseline for the empty set). For `k>=2`, a sorted-prefix implementation avoids subset enumeration:

$$a_{(i)}=\sum_{j<i}\frac{\binom{j}{k-2}}{\binom Nk}(g_{(i)}-g_{(j)}).$$

Set invalid binomial coefficients to zero. Ties need no arbitrary advantage: the tied differences vanish. Sort, compute prefix sums, then restore original sample order.

3. `pkpo_loss(log_probs, rewards, k)` returns `-mean_groups(sum_i(log_probs_i * a_i))`. `log_probs` has the same shape and represents the sampled actions' scalar log probabilities. Coefficients **already include sample normalization**; do not take another mean over N. Gradients flow through log probabilities only.

Supplied validation and binomial helpers can be reused. Inputs are finite CPU float32/float64 with nonempty leading groups. Preserve dtype, device, values and strided inputs. The scalar objective may differentiate through rewards; the policy weights must not. Support negative rewards, ties, `N=1`, `k=N`, and `N=256` without integer overflow.

Example: `rewards=[.2,.9,.4], k=3` gives weights `[0,.5,0]`. These are policy-gradient coefficients, not probabilities or centered GRPO advantages.

## Paper-native toy

Recreate §5.1: `X ~ Normal(theta, std=.1)`, reward `X²` inside `[0,1]`, zero outside. T3 computes expected-maximum curves and actual gradients of your policy loss for `k=1,4,8`. This independently recomputes the paper's toy setup on a smaller fixed CPU grid (2048 groups, N=16, 15 means); it does not reproduce exact published samples or train an LLM.
en.notes:
# Solution notes

An item contributes to Eq. (33) only when it is the unique largest reward in its subset. If its sorted index is i and the second-largest index is j<i, the remaining k-2 elements can be chosen in `C(j,k-2)` ways. Summing these weighted gaps gives the prefix formula. Two cumulative sums, one of coefficients and one of reward-weighted coefficients, give all weights after sorting. Equal values produce zero gaps and permutation-equivariant results.

For k=1 we choose zero baseline, recovering REINFORCE with reward/N. For k=N only the gap between the largest and second-largest reward survives; a tied maximum contributes zero. For k>=2 adding the same constant to every reward leaves these weights unchanged. An average of transformed rewards is not the leave-one-out baseline, since each coefficient already depends on the group.

The weights contain `1/C(N,k)` and must be summed against log probabilities. Only independent groups are averaged. Detach the sampled rewards and actions for a score-function estimator; otherwise a pathwise gradient changes the estimator.

## Source version and toy

The problem is associated with the NeurIPS 2025 paper and pins the [corrected v5 Eq. (33)](https://arxiv.org/html/2505.15201v5); it uses the subset definition rather than earlier recurrences with version-dependent corrections. The prefix implementation is independently derived, not copied from the paper's appendix code. The k=1 zero-baseline convention is stated explicitly because Eq. (33)'s max over an empty set needs a convention. We do not implement PPO clipping or the complete LLM optimizer.

The Gaussian toy retains the paper's standard deviation and reward support. It measures the objective and gradients on a bounded grid, not convergence or a quality benchmark. Independent subset enumeration checks finite groups; exhaustive Bernoulli sample enumeration verifies the unbiased pass@k gradient against `k*(1-p)^(k-1)`. Mutants catch mean reward, untransformed rewards, sorted output order and a second normalization.

provenance.adaptation: Original Normal(theta, std=0.1) and x^2 reward on [0,1]; 2048 groups of 16 samples, 15 means, k=1/4/8. Independently redrawn CPU curves; no paper figure pixels or LLM benchmark.

# SVDQuant 平滑、低秩与残差量化

实现 [SVDQuant v1 §4.2 Eq. (5)](https://arxiv.org/html/2411.05007v1) 的数值核心：把激活离群值迁移到权重，保留高精度主导低秩分量，对残差分支做量化。

## 函数

采用 `x[B,M]`、`weight[M,N]`、正且有限的 `scale[M]`。未量化输出是 `x@weight`，与 PyTorch Linear 的转置权重布局不同。

1. `smooth_inputs(x,weight,scale)` 返回 `(xs,ws)`：`xs=x/scale`、`ws=scale[:,None]*weight`，应保持 `xs@ws=x@weight`。
2. `split_weight(weight,rank)` 返回 `(left[M,r],right[r,N],residual[M,N])`，`left@right` 为截断 SVD 的最佳 rank-r 近似，`residual=weight-left@right`。允许奇异向量符号及等价因子分解不同，覆盖 `rank=0` 和 `rank=min(M,N)`。
3. `svdquant_linear(x,weight,scale,rank,bits=4)`：先平滑，再分解**平滑后的权重**，计算：

$$Y=(\hat X L_1)L_2+Q(\hat X)Q(R).$$

低秩分支必须接收**未量化的平滑激活**；低比特分支量化的是残差 R，不能量化完整平滑权重。已提供 `fake_quantize`：每个张量共享 `s=max(abs(z))/(2^(bits-1)-1)`，`Q(z)=s*clamp(round(z/s),-qmax,qmax)`，中点取偶数，零张量输出零，`2<=bits<=8`。

starter 已提供校验和量化。输入为有限 CPU float32/float64，同 dtype/device，维度非空。保留 dtype/device 与输入值，兼容非连续输入。本题为推理数值接口，不考查 SVD/rounding 梯度。

## Toy 实验

T3 构造含一个 30 倍通道的合成激活，通过提交函数计算输出误差及奇异值曲线，比较直接 W4A4、仅平滑与 rank 0–6 双分支结果。这是 Figures 4–5 的**教学改编**：平滑系数已给定，只做一次 SVD；高精度分支使用输入浮点 dtype，不模拟硬件 FP16。不含模型权重、校准搜索、迭代细化、FP4 编码、整数内核或 Nunchaku 延迟复现。核心同时包括平滑、低秩、残差量化，不将单独 SVD 当作完整系统。
problems.notes:
# 题解

按本题布局，激活通道除以 lambda，权重**行**乘以 lambda。截断 SVD 可取 `left=U[:,:r]*singular[:r]`、`right=Vh[:r]`，等价分解也可；先计算残差，再量化。Eq. (5) 的高精度支路接收 xs，低比特支路接收 Q(xs)。两支路都用量化激活，即使满秩也无法恢复精确线性输出。

## 来源与数值范围

[v1 §4.2](https://arxiv.org/html/2411.05007v1) 将平滑权重写作 `W diag(lambda)`，但其 W 定义为 `[M,N]`。该布局维度一致的式子是 `diag(lambda) W`，本题采用后者，并用非方阵测试避免转置歧义。输出遵守 Eq. (5)，测试比较因子乘积，不限定奇异向量符号。

[作者仓库](https://github.com/mit-han-lab/deepcompressor/)是校准与推理系统。本题独立实现给定平滑系数、一次 SVD，并将 Eq. (1) 固定为张量级对称整数 fake quantization；不模拟生产校准配置、低秩迭代细化、group/FP4 变体、存储打包或 Nunchaku 融合内核。CPU float32/float64 代表高精度支路，不能据此声称硬件加速或存储压缩。

受控离群值 toy 计算真实输出误差及残差奇异谱，仅展示选定矩阵；不保证任意输入增大 rank 后量化误差都单调下降。独立 oracle 使用已知旋转奇异向量与 Python 标量 rounding，覆盖 rank=0/满秩和零张量。四个 mutant 对应反向平滑、高精度激活被量化、完整权重被重复量化、遗漏奇异值。

en.title: SVDQuant Smoothing, Low-rank and Residual Quantization
en.readme:
# SVDQuant Smoothing, Low-rank and Residual Quantization

Implement the numerical core of [SVDQuant v1 §4.2, Eq. (5)](https://arxiv.org/html/2411.05007v1). Move activation outliers into the weights, retain dominant weight components at high precision, and quantize only the residual branch.

## Functions

Use `x[B,M]`, `weight[M,N]`, positive finite `scale[M]`; the unquantized output is `x @ weight` (not PyTorch Linear's transposed-weight layout).

1. `smooth_inputs(x, weight, scale)` returns `(xs, ws)` with `xs=x/scale`, `ws=scale[:,None]*weight`. This preserves `xs@ws=x@weight`.
2. `split_weight(weight, rank)` returns `(left[M,r], right[r,N], residual[M,N])`. `left@right` is a best rank-r approximation from truncated SVD and `residual=weight-left@right`. Any singular-vector signs or equivalent factorization are accepted. Support `rank=0` and `rank=min(M,N)`.
3. `svdquant_linear(x, weight, scale, rank, bits=4)` first smooths, then splits the **smoothed** weight, and computes

$$Y=(\hat X L_1)L_2+Q(\hat X)Q(R).$$

The low-rank branch uses **unquantized smoothed activations**. Quantize residual R, not the full smoothed weight. The provided `fake_quantize` uses one scale per tensor: `s=max(abs(z))/(2^(bits-1)-1)`, `Q(z)=s*clamp(round(z/s),-qmax,qmax)`, round ties to even, and zero maps to zero. `2<=bits<=8`.

The starter provides validation and quantization. Inputs are finite CPU float32/float64 with matching dtype/device and nonempty dimensions. Preserve dtype/device, support strided inputs and do not modify inputs. This is an inference numerical contract; gradients through SVD/rounding are outside the exercise.

## Toy experiment

T3 creates synthetic activations with one 30x channel, then recomputes output errors and singular-value curves through your functions. Compare naive W4A4, smoothing only and the two-branch approximation at ranks 0–6. This is a **teaching adaptation** of Figures 4–5, using given smoothing scales and a one-shot SVD. High precision means the input float dtype here, rather than hardware FP16. No checkpoint, calibration search, iterative refinement, FP4 encoding, integer kernels or Nunchaku latency reproduction is included. This is more than an SVD task, but still a bounded numerical core of the complete system.
en.notes:
# Solution notes

With the stated matrix layout, scale input channels by `1/lambda` and weight **rows** by `lambda`. Truncated SVD may use `left=U[:,:r]*singular[:r]`, `right=Vh[:r]`; another equivalent factorization is fine. Preserve the residual before fake quantization. In Eq. (5) the high-precision path sees xs, while the low-bit path sees Q(xs). A quantized input in both paths would lose the benefit even at full rank.

## Source and numerical scope

[The v1 text in §4.2](https://arxiv.org/html/2411.05007v1) writes the transformed weight as `W diag(lambda)` despite defining W[M,N]. For that layout the dimensionally consistent identity is `diag(lambda) W`, used here. The test's nonsquare matrix prevents this transpose ambiguity from passing unnoticed. The output follows Eq. (5) and tests compare products rather than singular-vector signs.

The [author implementation](https://github.com/mit-han-lab/deepcompressor/) is a calibration and inference system. This exercise independently implements one-shot SVD with supplied smoothing, and chooses an explicit per-tensor symmetric integer fake quantizer from Eq. (1). It does not model the full production calibration configuration, iterative low-rank refinement, grouped/FP4 variants, storage packing or Nunchaku fused kernels. CPU float32/float64 stand in for the high-precision branch; no hardware speed or compression claim follows.

The controlled outlier toy measures actual output error and residual spectrum. It demonstrates one deliberately chosen matrix; increasing rank or applying SVDQuant is not guaranteed to improve every arbitrary quantized matrix monotonically. Independent tests use known rotated singular vectors and Python scalar rounding, including rank-zero/full-rank and zero tensors. Mutants target reversed smoothing, quantized high-precision activations, quantizing the full weight twice, and omitted singular values.

problems.readme:
# MoGe 鲁棒最优对齐

实现 [MoGe](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.19115) 的鲁棒最优对齐（ROE）核心。预测点图存在未知全局尺度，以及相机 z 轴方向的平移。目标使用真实深度倒数作权重，逐坐标计算绝对残差：

$$
\min_{s,t}\sum_{i\in M}\sum_{d\in\{x,y,z\}}
\min\left(\frac{|s\hat p_{id}+t\mathbf 1_{d=z}-p_{id}|}{p_{iz}},\tau\right).
$$

`trunc=None` 时不截断。必须先乘权重，再对每个坐标的残差截断。旋转及 x/y 平移固定不变；本题优化的尺度是无约束实数。

## 实现接口

| 函数 | 输入 | 输出 |
|---|---|---|
| `optimal_scale_1d(x, y, weight, trunc=None)` | 三个同形状非空一维浮点张量，权重非负 | 标量 `scale`、最小目标值 |
| `roe_align(prediction, target, mask, trunc=None)` | 两个 `(N,3)` 点图及 `(N,)` 布尔掩码 | 标量 `scale`、标量 `z_shift` |

第一个函数求解 `sum(min(weight * abs(scale*x-y), trunc))`。全局最优解可在有效零残差折点 `y[i]/x[i]` 中找到，其中 `x[i] != 0` 且 `weight[i] > 0`。截断会增加折点，但这些折点的斜率变化不能创造严格局部极小值。多个折点目标值相同时选择最小尺度；没有有效系数时返回尺度零。

对点图，枚举有效锚点 `k`，令 `t = target[k,2] - s*prediction[k,2]`。只把所有点的 z 坐标减去锚点深度，保留 x/y 原值，每个锚点就得到一个一维尺度问题。选择目标值最小的候选。完整对齐允许返回任意全局最优解。

starter 已提供验证：有效目标深度必须为正、有限，输入使用相同 dtype/device 的 CPU float32/float64。先选取掩码中的有效点再计算；无效点允许含 NaN。不得修改输入，输出为相同 dtype/device 的、已 detach 的标量张量。作者训练代码会从选中锚点重建可微参数，这部分梯度路径不在本题范围内。

题目使用小规模精确枚举（测试 `N <= 64`），无需网络预测、多尺度球域或相机恢复。

## Toy：恢复带离群点的点云

**来源分类：teaching adaptation。** 六个生成点使用已知尺度与 z 平移，其中一个高杠杆坐标被破坏。你的函数绘制尺度目标曲线和恢复后的深度。截断 ROE 恢复内点，未截断拟合受到离群点影响。这是教学实验，不是 MoGe 原生 benchmark。

T0 检查接口；T1 使用独立标量计算与二维直线排列交点 oracle；T2 检查权重、截断顺序、掩码、平局与单位缩放；T3 调用提交函数产生图表。预览使用参考实现。

算法对照[作者的 `align` 与 `align_points_scale_z_shift`](https://github.com/microsoft/MoGe/blob/74fbce054ebed49800de42d0ad0e83495065719a/moge/utils/alignment.py)。教学版直接计算候选值，生产代码使用排序和 scatter 加速。
problems.notes:
# 参考实现说明

单个残差的零点折点使斜率向上跳，截断边界使斜率向下跳。因此可以用零残差折点表示最优解。系数为零的项仍贡献常数损失，权重为零的项不提供有效锚点。

点图只有两个未知量：共享 xyz 尺度与 z 平移。锚定一个深度即可消去平移；权重仍从原始目标深度计算。教学版对每个锚点枚举全部有效比值，最坏复杂度随点数立方增长；作者版使用排序后的斜率变化与批处理加速。这里不使用 L2 拟合、SVD、旋转或自由 xyz 平移。

测试使用独立的二维直线排列 oracle，包含零残差线与截断边界线，并比较最终目标值。这样在最优解不唯一时不强迫选择某个锚点。一维接口单独规定平局行为，完整对齐接受任意最优解。

逐坐标截断采用作者代码的 `min(weight*abs(residual), trunc)`。`weight*min(abs(residual), trunc)` 是不同的估计器，测试用不相等权重区分两者。掩码先于有限性和深度检查，避免无效像素污染结果。

toy 只报告内点恢复与目标曲线，不评价单目重建质量。本题对应 CVPR 2025 MoGe 的对齐核心；官方仓库现在也含后续 MoGe 版本。

en.title: MoGe Robust Optimal Alignment
en.readme:
# MoGe Robust Optimal Alignment

Implement the robust optimal alignment (ROE) core of [MoGe](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.19115). A predicted point map has an unknown shared scale and a shift along the camera's z axis. The alignment objective uses inverse target depth and coordinate-wise absolute residuals:

$$
\min_{s,t}\sum_{i\in M}\sum_{d\in\{x,y,z\}}
\min\left(\frac{|s\hat p_{id}+t\mathbf 1_{d=z}-p_{id}|}{p_{iz}},\tau\right).
$$

With `trunc=None`, omit the cap. The cap applies **after weighting** each coordinate. Rotation and x/y translation are fixed. Scale is an unconstrained real scalar for this optimization exercise.

## Implement

| Function | Inputs | Outputs |
|---|---|---|
| `optimal_scale_1d(x, y, weight, trunc=None)` | Same-shaped nonempty 1D floating tensors; nonnegative weights | Scalar `scale`, scalar minimum objective |
| `roe_align(prediction, target, mask, trunc=None)` | `(N,3)` point maps and Boolean `(N,)` valid mask | Scalar `scale`, scalar `z_shift` |

The first function solves `sum(min(weight * abs(scale*x-y), trunc))`. A global minimum can be found among active zero-residual breakpoints `y[i]/x[i]`, where `x[i] != 0` and `weight[i] > 0`. Truncation introduces additional kinks, but their slope changes cannot create a strict local minimum. For equal minimum values, choose the smallest active breakpoint; return scale zero if no coefficient is active.

For point maps, enumerate a valid anchor `k` and impose `t = target[k,2] - s*prediction[k,2]`. Subtract this anchor's depth from the z coordinates only; x/y are unchanged. Each anchor reduces the full problem to the 1D solver. Select the candidate with the lowest objective. Any global minimizer is accepted for the full alignment.

The supplied validation requires positive finite valid target depths and matching CPU float32/float64 tensors. Select valid points before arithmetic: masked coordinates may contain NaNs. Do not mutate inputs. Return detached scalar tensors of the input dtype/device. The official training implementation reconstructs differentiable parameters from selected anchors; that gradient path is outside this exercise.

Small exact enumeration is sufficient (`N <= 64` in the harness). Network prediction, multi-scale neighborhoods, and camera recovery are outside this module.

## Toy: recover a corrupted point cloud

**Provenance: teaching adaptation.** Six generated points have a known scale/z-shift and one high-leverage corrupted coordinate. Your functions produce a scale-objective curve and recovered depths. Truncated ROE recovers the inliers while untruncated fitting is distracted by the outlier. This is a new educational experiment, not a native MoGe benchmark.

T0 checks contracts; T1 uses independent scalar and 2D line-arrangement oracles; T2 checks weighting, truncation order, masking, ties and scene-unit equivariance. T3 calls the submitted functions and emits the toy charts. The preview uses the reference implementation.

The algorithm follows [the authors' `align` and `align_points_scale_z_shift`](https://github.com/microsoft/MoGe/blob/74fbce054ebed49800de42d0ad0e83495065719a/moge/utils/alignment.py); the educational implementation uses direct candidate evaluation instead of production sorting/scatter kernels.
en.notes:
# Reference notes

For a single residual, its center breakpoint changes the slope upward, while its two truncation boundaries change the slope downward. A minimum can therefore be represented by a zero-residual breakpoint. Constant terms from zero coefficients still contribute to the objective. Zero weights cannot supply useful anchors.

The point-map objective has only two unknowns: a shared xyz scale and a z shift. Anchoring one depth removes the shift; its inverse-depth weight is still computed from the original target depth. The implementation evaluates every active ratio per anchor, which has cubic worst-case cost in the tiny point count. MoGe's production solver uses sorted slope changes and batching. No L2 fit, SVD, rotation, or free xyz translation appears here.

Tests compare the achieved objective with a separate arrangement solver that includes center and saturation lines. This avoids requiring a particular anchor when several optima exist. The scalar contract deliberately specifies tie behavior; the full alignment contract accepts any minimizer.

The optional coordinate truncation follows the author code's `min(weight*abs(residual), trunc)` convention. Using `weight*min(abs(residual), trunc)` is a different estimator. This distinction is covered with unequal weights. Masking precedes finite/depth checks, so invalid camera pixels do not contaminate valid fitting.

The toy reports inlier recovery and objective curves, not monocular reconstruction quality. This package is based on CVPR 2025 MoGe's alignment core, even though the official repository now also contains later MoGe variants.

# DAPS 解耦后验采样

实现 [DAPS 式 (7) 与 Algorithm 1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.01521) 的局部后验采样核心。在当前噪声层，由已提供的 probability-flow ODE 输出 `x0_hat` 构建干净样本的高斯近似，在干净空间中结合观测做 MCMC，再独立加噪进入下一层。

线性观测 `y = A x + measurement_noise` 下：

$$
g(x)=\frac{\hat x_0-x}{r^2}+\frac{A^T(y-Ax)}{\beta^2},\quad
x' = x+\eta g(x)+\sqrt{2\eta}\epsilon,\quad
x_{\mathrm{next}}=x_0+\sigma_{\mathrm{next}}\epsilon'.
$$

`r`、`beta` 表示标准差；两份独立标准高斯噪声由调用者传入。下一噪声层以 MCMC 的干净样本为中心，标准差直接使用 `sigma_next`。

## 实现接口

| 函数 | 输入 | 输出 |
|---|---|---|
| `posterior_score(x, x0_hat, operator, measurement, r, beta)` | `x,x0_hat: (B,D)`，`operator: (M,D)`，`measurement: (B,M)` | `(B,D)` 条件 score |
| `langevin_step(x, score, eta, noise)` | 同形状张量与非负步长 | 一次 Langevin 更新 |
| `renoise(x0, sigma_next, noise)` | 同形状张量与非负噪声标准差 | 下一层噪声样本 |

批次中每个样本为行向量，预测观测为 `x @ operator.T`。score 是逐样本导数，不除以 batch 大小或坐标数量。MCMC 内层循环始终固定 `x0_hat`。保留 dtype/device，不修改输入；验证代码已提供，测试使用 CPU float32/float64。样本之间不进行隐式广播。

ODE、观测矩阵、调度、随机数和循环都是脚手架，学习者实现上述三个数学内核。无需下载模型或训练扩散网络。

## Toy：可解析的局部条件分布

**来源分类：teaching adaptation。** 二维 ODE 估计位于原点，高斯条件近似使用 `r=1`；观测为 `x[0]+0.5*x[1]=1.5`，测量标准差 `0.5`。4,096 条链向量化执行 240 步 Langevin，再独立以 `sigma_next=0.3` 加噪。

harness 解析计算条件均值与协方差，也计算有限步长 Langevin 的稳态协方差，显式区分离散步长偏差。图表展示观测一致性、条件均值收敛和协方差。这只验证一次 DAPS 局部转移，不代表完整逆问题求解，也不声称复现论文 Appendix G 的非线性 toy。

T0 检查接口；T1 对独立标量能量作数值求导并验证给定噪声的更新；T2 检查高斯驻点、批次独立性、观测零空间、噪声矩与组合转移；T3 调用你的函数生成实验图表。预览使用参考实现。
problems.notes:
# 参考实现说明

这里的高斯近似对应 `p(x0 | xt)`，不是直接近似全局无条件数据先验。完整 DAPS 外层循环会在每个噪声层重新运行 ODE 得到 `x0_hat`，并由调度设置 `r`。本题显式接收这些量，将论文的可微观测函数收窄为矩阵，以便独立验证似然 score。

[作者 sampler](https://github.com/zhangbingliang2019/DAPS/blob/main/cores/mcmc.py) 的 Gaussian 分支先得到 `(x0hat-xt)/sigma^2`，再加 `(xt-x)/sigma^2`，相加即 `(x0hat-x)/sigma^2`；Langevin 更新使用 `sqrt(2*lr)`。本题显式保留论文中的一般参数 `r`，作者默认 Gaussian 实现是 `r=sigma` 的特例。

教学条件分布的精度矩阵为 `H = I/r^2 + A.T@A/beta^2`，均值为 `H^-1(x0_hat/r^2 + A.T@y/beta^2)`，真实协方差为 `H^-1`。稳定的未校正 Langevin 更新，其稳态协方差为 `(H-eta*H@H/2)^-1`。toy 同时记录两者，避免把有限步长采样误称为精确后验采样。

Appendix G 使用双分量高斯混合和非线性测量。文中展示的测量公式配合 `y=0`，不能直接解释同段描述的似然模态。2026-10-13 检查的公开仓库文件树中未找到能澄清约定的可运行 synthetic/toy 脚本。因此本题明确使用新设计的线性高斯教学实验，不擅自修改原文 toy；score、Langevin 系数和重加噪内核仍对齐式 (7) 与 Algorithm 1。

显式噪声参数使 harness 可重复，独立抽样由调用者负责；组合测试和实验使用不同的 MCMC 噪声与下一层噪声。本实验不评价真实图像恢复、全局混合或预训练模型质量。

en.title: DAPS Decoupled Posterior Sampling
en.readme:
# DAPS Decoupled Posterior Sampling

Implement the local posterior-sampling kernel in [DAPS, Eq. (7) and Algorithm 1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.01521). At a noise level, a supplied probability-flow ODE estimate `x0_hat` defines a Gaussian approximation to the clean sample. Measurement conditioning happens in clean space, followed by independent re-noising to the next level.

For a linear observation `y = A x + measurement_noise`, use:

$$
g(x)=\frac{\hat x_0-x}{r^2}+\frac{A^T(y-Ax)}{\beta^2},\quad
x' = x+\eta g(x)+\sqrt{2\eta}\epsilon,\quad
x_{\mathrm{next}}=x_0+\sigma_{\mathrm{next}}\epsilon'.
$$

Here `r` and `beta` are standard deviations. The two noises are independent standard-normal draws supplied by the caller. The final formula centers the next noise level on the MCMC clean sample, with standard deviation `sigma_next`.

## Implement

| Function | Inputs | Output |
|---|---|---|
| `posterior_score(x, x0_hat, operator, measurement, r, beta)` | `x,x0_hat: (B,D)`, `operator: (M,D)`, `measurement: (B,M)` | `(B,D)` conditional score |
| `langevin_step(x, score, eta, noise)` | Matching tensors and a nonnegative step size | One Langevin update |
| `renoise(x0, sigma_next, noise)` | Matching tensors and a nonnegative noise standard deviation | A sample at the next noise level |

Use row-vector batches, so predicted measurements are `x @ operator.T`. Scores are per-sample derivatives: do not divide by the batch size or the number of coordinates. Keep `x0_hat` fixed throughout the inner MCMC loop. Preserve dtype/device and input values; validation is supplied. Tests use CPU float32/float64. No implicit broadcasting across samples is allowed.

The ODE, measurement operator, schedules, random numbers and integration loop are scaffolding. You implement these three mathematical kernels. There are no model downloads or diffusion-network training tasks.

## Toy: an analytic local conditional

**Provenance: teaching adaptation.** Start with an ODE estimate at the origin in two dimensions, a Gaussian conditional approximation with `r=1`, and the observation `x[0]+0.5*x[1]=1.5` with measurement standard deviation `0.5`. Run 4,096 chains for 240 vectorized Langevin steps, then independently re-noise at `sigma_next=0.3`.

The harness computes the conditional mean and covariance analytically. It also computes the finite-step Langevin stationary covariance; a fixed nonzero step size has discretization bias. Charts show measurement consistency, convergence to the conditional mean, and covariance. This experiment validates one DAPS transition, not an entire diffusion inverse-problem solver or the paper's nonlinear Appendix G toy.

T0 checks contracts; T1 differentiates an independent scalar energy and checks explicit-noise updates; T2 checks Gaussian stationary points, batch independence, null-space behavior, noise moments and a composed transition. T3 calls your functions and records the toy artifacts. Preview plots use the reference implementation.
en.notes:
# Reference notes

The Gaussian approximation is to `p(x0 | xt)`, not directly to the global unconditional data prior. In a real DAPS outer loop, the ODE recomputes `x0_hat` and the schedule selects `r` at each noise level. This module accepts those quantities explicitly. Specializing the paper's differentiable observation map to a matrix makes the likelihood score independently testable.

The [author sampler](https://github.com/zhangbingliang2019/DAPS/blob/main/cores/mcmc.py) constructs its Gaussian prior contribution as `(x0hat - xt)/sigma^2`, then adds `(xt-x)/sigma^2`; these combine to `(x0hat-x)/sigma^2`. Its Langevin update uses `sqrt(2*lr)`. The exercise exposes the paper's general `r` explicitly, so the code's Gaussian default is the special case `r=sigma`.

For the teaching conditional, precision is `H = I/r^2 + A.T@A/beta^2`, mean is `H^-1(x0_hat/r^2 + A.T@y/beta^2)`, and true covariance is `H^-1`. A stable unadjusted Langevin step has stationary covariance `(H - eta*H@H/2)^-1`. The toy checks both, avoiding an incorrect claim of exact posterior sampling at finite step size.

Appendix G describes a two-component Gaussian mixture and a nonlinear observation toy. The displayed observation equation with `y=0` does not clearly support the stated likelihood modes. The public repository tree inspected on 2026-10-13 did not expose a runnable synthetic/toy script that resolves this convention. Therefore this package uses a clearly labeled new linear-Gaussian exercise rather than silently altering the paper's toy. Its score, Langevin scaling and re-noising kernel still follow Eq. (7) and Algorithm 1.

Fresh noise is an explicit argument to keep the harness deterministic. The caller is responsible for independent draws; the composed test and experiment use distinct MCMC and annealing samples. No claim is made about real-image restoration, global posterior mixing or pretrained-model quality.

# DiffusionNFT 正负双分支流匹配

实现 [DiffusionNFT 式 (5)](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.16117v1#S3.SS2)。单个可训练 velocity `v_current` 围绕固定 rollout velocity `v_old` 隐式定义两个策略：

$$
v^+=(1-\beta)v_{old}+\beta v_{current},\qquad
v^-=(1+\beta)v_{old}-\beta v_{current}.
$$

给定前向过程的 velocity 目标 `v` 及 `[0,1]` 内的最优性概率 `r`，优化：

$$
\mathcal L=\operatorname{mean}_{b}\left[r_b\|v_b^+-v_b\|_2^2+(1-r_b)\|v_b^--v_b\|_2^2\right].
$$

隐式分支使用 **beta 本身**，不是倒数。负样本通过非负平方误差训练负分支，不能改成给 MSE 乘负奖励。

## 实现接口

| 函数 | 输入 | 输出 |
|---|---|---|
| `implicit_velocities(current, old, beta)` | 两个同形状 `(B,...)` velocity 与正有限 beta | 正 velocity、负 velocity，按此顺序 |
| `nft_loss(current, old, target, rewards, beta)` | 三个匹配的 velocity 与 `(B,)` 奖励 | 标量损失 |

对**所有非 batch 坐标求平方和**，然后对样本求平均。这明确了图像或 token 形状特征的归约约定。奖励已是归一化概率，不要在函数内裁剪、再归一化或跨样本广播。starter 提供验证，使用非空 CPU float32/float64 输入。

梯度仅进入 `current`。在 `implicit_velocities` 内 detach `old`；在 `nft_loss` 内 detach `target` 和 `rewards`，即使这些输入意外启用了梯度也应如此。保留输入值和 dtype/device。

前向加噪、rollout 数据与训练循环均由脚手架提供。toy 约定 `x_t=(1-t)*x0+t*noise`，velocity 目标为 `noise-x0`。在线生成、奖励模型及旧策略 EMA 更新不在本题范围内。

## Toy：正样本、负样本和中性样本

**来源分类：teaching adaptation。** 固定二维前向过程 minibatch 的五个奖励为 `0`、`0.25`、`0.5`、`0.75`、`1`。用你的损失优化其 velocity 输出，并与独立推导的二次目标最优点比较：

$$
v_{current}^*=v_{old}+\frac{2r-1}{\beta}(v-v_{old}).
$$

正负样本推动相反方向，中性样本停留在旧 velocity。图表展示损失收敛与不同奖励对应的轨迹。这是小规模输出空间实验，不声称完成在线策略改进或复现图像生成 benchmark。

T0 检查接口；T1 使用独立标量公式及端点奖励；T2 验证解析梯度、冻结上下文、中性锚定、反射对称、特征归约与闭式最优点；T3 调用提交函数执行训练并生成图表。预览使用参考实现。
problems.notes:
# 参考实现说明

令 `d=current-old`、`e=old-target`，逐样本目标展开为 `||e||^2 + beta^2||d||^2 + 2*beta*(2*r-1)<e,d>`。batch 平均前，当前策略梯度为 `2*beta*(beta*d+(2*r-1)*e)`。测试用这个独立展开验证梯度与最优点。

奖励为二分之一时交叉项消失，优化把当前策略拉回旧策略。奖励为零时，拟合负分支会让当前策略相对旧策略朝远离目标的方向移动。丢弃负样本或直接使用带符号 MSE 都会破坏该行为。

论文公式使用特征求和的欧氏范数。生产训练可能将特征归一化和时间权重并入优化约定；harness 明确固定归约方式。本题只实现基本式 (5)，不隐含加入自适应权重、EMA 调度或奖励归一化。

原论文允许任意黑盒采样器收集干净数据。toy 改为给定固定 minibatch，并独立优化每个 velocity 输出，所测最优点展示局部目标，不代表有限容量 denoiser 或整体奖励一定改善。时间方向采用论文 rectified-flow 的数据到噪声约定，由零走向一。

旧 rollout 策略、干净目标和奖励概率都是固定上下文。测试故意为这些输入开启 `requires_grad`，检查意外梯度泄漏。四个 mutation 分别覆盖 beta 倒数、负分支符号、丢弃负样本、训练旧策略。

en.title: DiffusionNFT Positive and Negative Flow Matching
en.readme:
# DiffusionNFT Positive and Negative Flow Matching

Implement [DiffusionNFT Eq. (5)](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.16117v1#S3.SS2). One trainable velocity `v_current` implicitly represents two policies around a frozen rollout velocity `v_old`:

$$
v^+=(1-\beta)v_{old}+\beta v_{current},\qquad
v^-=(1+\beta)v_{old}-\beta v_{current}.
$$

For a forward-process velocity target `v` and an optimality probability `r` in `[0,1]`, optimize

$$
\mathcal L=\operatorname{mean}_{b}\left[r_b\|v_b^+-v_b\|_2^2+(1-r_b)\|v_b^--v_b\|_2^2\right].
$$

Use **beta**, not its reciprocal, in the implicit branches. Negative examples train the negative branch with a nonnegative squared error; they are not a negative-weight MSE.

## Implement

| Function | Inputs | Outputs |
|---|---|---|
| `implicit_velocities(current, old, beta)` | Same-shaped `(B,...)` velocities and positive finite beta | Positive and negative velocities, in that order |
| `nft_loss(current, old, target, rewards, beta)` | Three matching velocities and `(B,)` rewards | Scalar loss |

Sum squared errors over **all non-batch coordinates**, then average over examples. This fixes the convention for image or token-shaped features. Rewards are already normalized probabilities; do not clip, normalize, or broadcast them across different samples. Validation is supplied, with nonempty CPU float32/float64 inputs.

Gradients must flow only into `current`. Detach `old` inside `implicit_velocities`; detach `target` and `rewards` inside `nft_loss`, even if those inputs accidentally require gradients. Preserve input values and dtype/device.

Forward noising, rollout data and training loops are provided scaffolding. The toy uses `x_t=(1-t)*x0+t*noise`, so its velocity target is `noise-x0`. Online rollout generation, reward models and old-policy EMA updates are outside this module.

## Toy: positive, negative and neutral examples

**Provenance: teaching adaptation.** A fixed two-dimensional forward-process minibatch has five rewards: `0`, `0.25`, `0.5`, `0.75`, `1`. Optimize its velocity outputs with your loss and compare with the independently derived quadratic optimum:

$$
v_{current}^*=v_{old}+\frac{2r-1}{\beta}(v-v_{old}).
$$

Positive and negative examples move in opposite directions; a neutral example stays at the old velocity. Charts show loss convergence and the per-reward velocity trajectory. This deliberately small output-space experiment does not claim online policy improvement or image-generation benchmark reproduction.

T0 checks contracts; T1 uses independent scalar formulas and endpoint rewards; T2 checks analytic gradients, frozen context, neutral anchoring, reflection symmetry, feature reduction and closed-form optima. T3 trains with your submitted functions and records the charts. The preview uses the reference implementation.
en.notes:
# Reference notes

Write `d=current-old` and `e=old-target`. The per-example objective expands to `||e||^2 + beta^2||d||^2 + 2*beta*(2*r-1)<e,d>`. Its current-policy gradient is `2*beta*(beta*d+(2*r-1)*e)` before batch averaging. This independent expansion supplies the gradient and optimum oracles.

At reward one-half, the cross term vanishes: optimization pulls toward the old policy. At reward zero, minimizing the negative branch pushes the current policy away from the target relative to the old policy. This behavior is lost if negative examples are discarded or if a signed MSE replaces the implicit policy construction.

The equation uses a feature-summed Euclidean norm. Production training may absorb feature normalization and time weighting into optimization choices; the harness fixes the exact reduction explicitly. The scope is the paper's basic Eq. (5), without practical adaptive weighting, EMA scheduling or reward normalization. Those are separate choices and are not silently introduced here.

The original paper allows arbitrary black-box samplers to collect clean data. The toy supplies a frozen minibatch instead and independently optimizes each velocity output. Its measured optimum demonstrates the local objective, not a theorem about a finite-capacity denoiser or global reward improvement. Data-to-noise time runs from zero to one, matching the paper's rectified-flow convention.

The old rollout policy, clean target and reward probability are fixed context. Tests intentionally set their `requires_grad` flags to catch accidental gradient leakage. Four mutations target reciprocal beta, the negative branch sign, omission of negative samples, and training the old policy.

problems.readme:
# VAR 下一尺度预测

[VAR](https://arxiv.org/html/2404.02905v2) 每一步并行预测一个完整分辨率的 token map。本题实现冻结 tokenizer 的训练输入构造和注意力 mask。[官方代码](https://github.com/FoundationVision/VAR/blob/main/models/quant.py) 用**更低尺度** token 的累计重建，作为当前尺度的输入。

## 需要实现

`next_scale_inputs(token_maps, codebook, projections) -> Tensor`

输入是 `K` 个整数目标图 `[B,n_k,n_k]`。已提供 `lift_codes`，完成查码本、bicubic 放大、通道投影。记最大尺度 `H=n_K`，预测第 `k>0` 个尺度的输入为

$$F_{<k}=\sum_{j<k}\operatorname{lift\_codes}(r_j,Z,P_j,H),\qquad x_k=\operatorname{area}_{n_k}(F_{<k}).$$

将每个 `x_k` 按空间行优先顺序展开为 `[B,n_k²,C]`，再拼接 `k=1,…,K−1`，返回 `[B,Σ_{k>0}n_k²,C]`。第一尺度另有 class/start embedding，因此本函数不为它返回一行；`K=1` 时返回 `[B,0,C]`。最后一个目标图不会进入任何输入。

`scale_causal_mask(scales, device=None) -> Tensor`

返回布尔矩阵 `[L,L]`，其中 `L=Σn_k²`，`True` 表示**可见**。尺度 `i` 的 query 可读尺度 `j` 的 key，当且仅当 `j≤i`。同尺度内部所有位置互相可见，包括逆 raster 方向。[官方 mask](https://github.com/FoundationVision/VAR/blob/main/models/var.py) 采用这一规则。此处不会泄漏同尺度答案，因为这些输入位置装的是更低尺度重建，而不是自己的目标 token。

## 约定

尺度从 `1` 开始，均为正整数并严格递增；token 图均为正方形，共享 `B>0`。token dtype 为 int64，范围 `[0,V)`；共享码本为 `[V,C]`，投影为 `[K,C,C]`。浮点输入有限，使用 CPU float32/float64，dtype/device 一致，允许非连续张量。不得修改输入，应保持 dtype/device。这里 tokenizer 已冻结，模板中的 `no_grad` 应保留。

`lift_codes` 已给出：先用 `align_corners=False` 的 bicubic 放大到最大分辨率，再逐像素计算 `P_k @ feature`。原系统的 `Phi` 使用已学习的空间卷积；本题用固定通道矩阵缩小实现范围。位置编码、类别条件、码本训练和完整 Transformer 均不属于本题接口。

## 小实验

教学改编采用 1×1、2×2、4×4 目标图和一个固定注意力层，输入与 mask 均调用你的实现。改变某一目标图后，同尺度和更粗尺度的预测都应保持不变；更低尺度的信息应能影响更细尺度。另一张图比较 VAR 与 raster causal attention 的可见 key 数量。这是信息流实验，不是图像生成基准复现。
problems.notes:
# 参考说明

累计特征始终保留在**最大分辨率**。加入一个放大后的残差图，将累计和 area 下采样到下一尺度，再保存该输入块。只保留最新残差会丢失粗尺度上下文；加入下一尺度目标 token 会泄漏答案。

尺度因果 mask 包含整个对角块，而不是块内的下三角。对角块大小为 `n_k² × n_k²`，尺度边长不等于 token 数。本题约定 `True = 可见`，所以 `masked_fill(..., -inf)` 应使用它的取反。

测试通过独立的标量查表与通道求和 oracle、精确可见性矩阵、目标扰动及分样本对照验证。T3 将你实现的两个函数与实际 softmax attention 组合，目标变化只能影响更细尺度输出。

本题范围是冻结 tokenizer 的输入构造，使用共享欧氏码本和给定通道投影。原论文中的已学习空间投影、图像编码器/解码器和 Transformer 训练没有在小实验中复现。

en.title: VAR Next-Scale Prediction
en.readme:
# VAR Next-Scale Prediction

[VAR](https://arxiv.org/html/2404.02905v2) predicts a whole resolution level at a time. Implement two functions that prepare frozen tokenizer features and the training attention mask. The [official implementation](https://github.com/FoundationVision/VAR/blob/main/models/quant.py) constructs each input from a cumulative reconstruction of **earlier** token maps.

## Implement

`next_scale_inputs(token_maps, codebook, projections) -> Tensor`

The list contains `K` integer target maps `[B,n_k,n_k]`. Let `lift_codes` be the supplied lookup → bicubic upsample → channel projection helper, and let `H=n_K`. For the input predicting scale `k>0`, compute

$$F_{<k}=\sum_{j<k}\operatorname{lift\_codes}(r_j,Z,P_j,H),\qquad x_k=\operatorname{area}_{n_k}(F_{<k}).$$

Flatten each `x_k` in row-major spatial order into `[B,n_k²,C]`, then concatenate for `k=1,…,K−1`. The result is `[B,Σ_{k>0}n_k²,C]`. The first scale uses a separate class/start embedding and contributes no row to this function. For `K=1`, return `[B,0,C]`. The last target map is never used as an input.

`scale_causal_mask(scales, device=None) -> Tensor`

Return boolean `[L,L]`, with `L=Σn_k²` and `True` meaning **visible**. Query at scale `i` may read a key at scale `j` exactly when `j≤i`. Thus every same-scale pair is visible, even in reverse raster order. [The official mask](https://github.com/FoundationVision/VAR/blob/main/models/var.py) follows this rule. Same-scale attention is safe because those positions contain lower-scale features, not their target tokens.

## Contract

Scales are positive, strictly increasing integers beginning at `1`; all maps are square and share `B>0`. Token maps are int64 with indices in `[0,V)`. The shared codebook is `[V,C]` and the supplied projections are `[K,C,C]`. Inputs are finite CPU float32/float64 tensors with matching floating dtype/device; strided tensors are valid. Preserve values, dtype and device. The tokenizer is frozen: the supplied `no_grad` wrapper is intentional.

`lift_codes` is already implemented. It uses `align_corners=False` bicubic interpolation to the largest resolution, followed by `P_k @ feature` at each pixel. In the original system `Phi` contains learned spatial convolutions; fixed channel matrices keep this exercise focused. Position embeddings, class conditioning, codebook training and the Transformer are outside this contract.

## Toy

A teaching adaptation uses 1×1, 2×2 and 4×4 target maps and a fixed attention layer. Your two functions control the entire information path. Changing a target map must not change predictions at its own or any coarser scale; earlier maps must still influence finer predictions. The chart also compares visible-key counts with raster causal attention. This is an information-flow experiment, not an image-generation benchmark.
en.notes:
# Reference notes

Keep the cumulative feature map at the **largest** resolution. Add one lifted residual map, area-resize the sum to the next resolution, and only then append that input block. Replacing the cumulative sum with the latest map drops coarse context. Using the next target map in that addition leaks the answer.

A block-causal mask includes the full diagonal block, not only its lower triangle. Its diagonal blocks have sizes `n_k² × n_k²`; resolutions are not token counts. The boolean convention here is `True = visible`, so pass its inverse to `masked_fill(..., -inf)`.

Tests use an independent scalar lookup and channel-sum oracle, exact visibility matrices, target perturbations and separate-example checks. T3 composes your two functions with actual softmax attention; the output effect of each target perturbation must be strictly directed toward finer scales.

Scope: frozen tokenizer target preparation, shared Euclidean codebook, supplied channel projections. The full paper's learned spatial projection, encoder/decoder and Transformer training are intentionally not approximated by performance claims.

problems.readme:
# VAR 多尺度残差量化

实现 [VAR](https://arxiv.org/html/2404.02905v2) 使用的冻结潜空间 tokenizer：每个尺度量化前面尺度尚未解释的特征。算法 1–2 给出编码与重建过程，[官方代码](https://github.com/FoundationVision/VAR/blob/main/models/quant.py) 确定了 area 与 bicubic 插值约定。

## 需要实现

`multiscale_quantize(features, codebook, scales, projections) -> (token_maps, reconstructions)`

初始化残差 `e=features` 和最大分辨率重建 `f_hat=0`。依次处理由小到大的尺度 `n_k`：

1. 调用已提供的 `resize_residual(e,n_k)`，逐空间位置在共享码本中寻找平方欧氏距离最小的向量。距离完全相同时选择最小索引。
2. 调用 `lift_codes(indices,codebook,projections[k],H)`，得到最大分辨率贡献 `h_k`。
3. 更新 `e=e−h_k`、`f_hat=f_hat+h_k`，保存整数 token 图和 `f_hat` 的独立快照。

返回 `K` 个 int64 图 `[B,n_k,n_k]`，以及 `K` 个累计浮点重建 `[B,C,H,H]`。最后一个尺度处理剩余的全分辨率残差，不能在每个尺度都重新量化原始特征。

`decode_multiscale(token_maps, codebook, projections) -> Tensor`

将每个 token 图放大、投影到最大分辨率后相加，返回 `[B,C,H,H]`。同一组 token 与投影的解码结果，必须等于编码时最后一个累计重建。

## 已提供 helper 与约定

`resize_residual` 使用 area 插值；`lift_codes` 完成码本查表、`align_corners=False` 的 bicubic 放大、通道矩阵乘法。二者已提供。本教学题用给定 `[K,C,C]` 矩阵替代原系统已学习的空间 `Phi` 层；码本选择不使用余弦归一化。

`features` 是有限、非空、正方形 `[B,C,H,H]`；共享码本为 `[V,C]`，`V,C>0`。浮点输入使用 CPU float32/float64，dtype/device 一致，允许非连续张量。尺度是从 `1` 到 `H` 严格递增的正整数，允许 `K=1,H=1`。解码 token 图遵守同样尺度约定，使用有效范围内的 int64 索引。不得修改输入，各尺度快照不得共享同一可变存储。

这里 tokenizer 已冻结，模板保留 `no_grad`。无需实现直通梯度、码本更新、commitment loss、编码器或图像解码器。

## 小实验

教学改编使用一张 8×8 潜特征图，包含粗粒度区域与小幅交替细节，配以九个标量码和恒等投影。你的编码、解码函数生成重建误差曲线与一行潜特征对照，检查细节恢复及编码/解码一致性。实验不假定任意码本、投影的每一个中间尺度都一定降低误差，也不声称复现 ImageNet 训练。
problems.notes:
# 参考说明

残差始终保留原始潜特征分辨率。只在选择当前尺度索引时缩小残差；选出的码必须放大回最大分辨率后再相减。共享码本不代表所有尺度都量化同一张特征图。

参考实现用广播计算平方距离，也可用范数与内积等价计算，但并列最小值必须选择最小索引。通道投影发生在选码之后，其影响必须同时计入下一步残差和累计重建。

测试包含可手算的两尺度案例、非均匀尺度与非恒等通道矩阵的标量最近邻 oracle、独立构造的解码期望、冻结输出语义和样本独立性。对于稠密标量码本和恒等的最后投影，只要残差在码本范围内，最终误差不超过半个量化间距。

toy 中固定码本能改善所选潜特征；误差逐尺度单调下降不是任意已学习投影残差量化的一般不变量。可训练 VQ-VAE 的 autograd 属于另一个实现范围，本题只实现确定性的冻结 token 生成。

en.title: VAR Multiscale Residual Quantization
en.readme:
# VAR Multiscale Residual Quantization

Implement the frozen latent tokenizer behind [VAR](https://arxiv.org/html/2404.02905v2). Each scale quantizes what the earlier scales have left unexplained. Algorithms 1–2 define this encoding/reconstruction loop; [the official implementation](https://github.com/FoundationVision/VAR/blob/main/models/quant.py) gives the area and bicubic interpolation conventions.

## Implement

`multiscale_quantize(features, codebook, scales, projections) -> (token_maps, reconstructions)`

Start with residual `e=features` and full-resolution reconstruction `f_hat=0`. For every scale `n_k`, in ascending order:

1. Call supplied `resize_residual(e,n_k)` and choose the nearest shared codebook vector at each spatial position, minimizing squared Euclidean distance. Break exact ties with the lowest code index.
2. Use supplied `lift_codes(indices,codebook,projections[k],H)` to turn the selected codes into a full-resolution contribution `h_k`.
3. Update `e=e−h_k` and `f_hat=f_hat+h_k`. Save the integer map and an independent snapshot of `f_hat`.

Return `K` int64 maps `[B,n_k,n_k]` and `K` cumulative floating reconstructions `[B,C,H,H]`. The last scale quantizes the remaining full-resolution residual; do not quantize the original feature map repeatedly.

`decode_multiscale(token_maps, codebook, projections) -> Tensor`

Lift every map to the largest resolution and sum the contributions. Return `[B,C,H,H]`. The same token maps and projections must recover the encoder's final cumulative reconstruction.

## Provided helpers and contract

`resize_residual` uses area interpolation; `lift_codes` performs lookup, bicubic upsampling with `align_corners=False`, then a channel matrix multiplication. Both are provided. The original learned spatial `Phi` layers are replaced by given `[K,C,C]` matrices in this teaching exercise. No cosine-normalized code selection is used.

`features` is finite, nonempty, square `[B,C,H,H]`. The shared codebook is `[V,C]`, with `V,C>0`. All floating inputs are CPU float32/float64 and share dtype/device; noncontiguous tensors are supported. Scales are strictly increasing positive integers starting at `1` and ending at `H`; `K=1,H=1` is valid. Input token maps to decoding obey the same scale schedule and use in-range int64 indices. Do not mutate inputs or alias the saved reconstruction snapshots.

This is a frozen tokenizer. The provided `no_grad` wrappers are intentional: no straight-through estimator, codebook update, commitment loss, encoder or image decoder is required.

## Toy

A teaching adaptation quantizes an 8×8 latent containing coarse regions and a small alternating detail pattern, using nine scalar codes and identity projections. Your encoding and decoding functions produce a reconstruction-error curve and a latent row plot. The example checks detail recovery and encode/decode agreement. It does not assume that each intermediate scale must always reduce error for arbitrary codebooks/projections, and does not reproduce ImageNet training.
en.notes:
# Reference notes

The residual lives at the original latent resolution. Resize it only to decide each scale's indices; lift selected codes back to full resolution before subtracting. A shared codebook does not mean every scale sees the same feature map.

The reference computes squared distances by broadcasting. Algebraic norms/dot products are also valid within tolerance; ties must still select the first code. Channel projection happens after code selection. Its effect is part of both the next residual and cumulative reconstruction.

Tests include a hand-computed two-scale example, a scalar nearest-neighbor oracle with nonuniform resolutions and nonidentity channel maps, independently constructed decoder expectations, frozen-output semantics and per-example independence. With a dense scalar codebook and identity last projection, the last-scale error is bounded by half a quantization interval when the residual remains in range.

The toy's fixed codebook happens to improve the selected latent. Monotonic error reduction is not a general invariant of learned projected residual quantization. Autograd of a trainable VQ-VAE is a separate module; this exercise implements deterministic frozen token generation.

problems.readme:
# FD-loss 总体矩与 EMA

实现 [Representation Fréchet Loss for Visual Generation 第 3.2 节](https://arxiv.org/html/2604.28190)中的总体统计估计器。FD-loss 用历史信息估计特征分布，同时只对当前微批次求梯度。论文默认的 EMA 版本保存均值和**原始二阶矩**。

对当前特征 $X\in\mathbb R^{B\times D}$，先计算

$$
\mu_b=\frac1B\sum_i x_i,\qquad M_b=\frac1B\sum_i x_i x_i^\top.
$$

再实现 Eq.(4)-(5)：

$$
\mu=\beta\,\operatorname{sg}(\mu_{old})+(1-\beta)\mu_b,\quad
M=\beta\,\operatorname{sg}(M_{old})+(1-\beta)M_b,\quad
\Sigma=M-\mu\mu^\top.
$$

## 需要实现

| 函数 | 返回值 |
|---|---|
| `batch_moments(features)` | `(mean, raw_second)`，形状分别为 `(D,)`、`(D,D)` |
| `ema_population_stats(features, old_mean, old_second, beta)` | 按顺序返回 `(mean, raw_second, covariance)` |

输入使用相同的 float32/float64 类型和设备，`B>=1`、`D>=1`，`beta` 在 `[0,1]` 内；端点用于测试。历史输入表示有效且有限的总体矩。类型、维度和有限值检查已提供。保留输入数值，不要原地更新历史。

所有批次矩都除以 **B**，`B=1` 时也成立。`raw_second` 是 `E[xx^T]`，不是中心化协方差。在 `ema_population_stats` 内部对两个历史张量停止梯度，即使调用方给它们设置了 `requires_grad=True`。返回的三个统计量必须保留当前批次的梯度。调用方使用 `mean.detach()`、`raw_second.detach()` 保存下一步历史，脚手架负责这部分状态管理。

例如：当前单个特征为 `[3]`，历史均值为 `[1]`、原始二阶矩为 `[[2]]`，`beta=.5`。应得到均值 `[2]`、原始二阶矩 `[[5.5]]`、协方差 `[[1.5]]`。直接对两个协方差做 EMA 会错误地得到 `[[.5]]`。

本题使用论文的 **EMA 总体矩约定**。官方 FIFO 队列分支使用 `N-1` 计算样本协方差，那是另一种估计器，不属于本题范围；不要把它的 Bessel 修正加进 EMA 公式。

## Toy：小批次中的总体信息

**来源：教学改编。** 两组平移后的二维特征总共包含八个点。四十个微批次交替来自两组，因此单个批次不能代表总体。脚手架用这八个点暖启动 EMA，再调用你的函数比较当前批次与 EMA 的估计误差。图表展示均值、方差和总体矩误差。这是为理解估计器构造的确定性特征流，不是论文原图，也不代表变化中的真实数据总会得到同样结果。

原论文在后训练之前用基础生成器暖启动统计量。本实验直接提供特征以隔离统计估计器。Fréchet 损失、图像编码器、多设备收集与生成器优化不在本题范围内。

T0 检查接口；T1 使用标量矩和显式加权总体作为独立答案；T2 验证停止历史梯度、当前梯度解析式、EMA 端点、仿射变换和多步几何权重；T3 用你的提交运行特征流。预览图使用参考实现。
problems.solution:
"""FD-loss population moments, with gradients restricted to the current batch."""
import math
import torch
from torch import Tensor


def _check_features(features):
    if features.ndim != 2 or min(features.shape) < 1 or features.dtype not in (torch.float32, torch.float64):
        raise ValueError("features must be a nonempty float32/float64 (B,D) tensor")
    if not torch.isfinite(features).all():
        raise ValueError("features must be finite")


def _check_history(features, old_mean, old_second, beta):
    _check_features(features)
    d = features.shape[1]
    if old_mean.shape != (d,) or old_second.shape != (d, d):
        raise ValueError("history must have shapes (D,) and (D,D)")
    for value in (old_mean, old_second):
        if value.dtype != features.dtype or value.device != features.device or not torch.isfinite(value).all():
            raise ValueError("finite history must match feature dtype/device")
    if not math.isfinite(beta) or not 0 <= beta <= 1:
        raise ValueError("beta must be finite and in [0,1]")


def batch_moments(features: Tensor) -> tuple[Tensor, Tensor]:
    """Return mean and RAW second moment E[xx^T], divided by B."""
    _check_features(features)
    mean = features.mean(0)
    second = features.T @ features / features.shape[0]
    return mean, second


def ema_population_stats(features: Tensor, old_mean: Tensor, old_second: Tensor,
                         beta: float) -> tuple[Tensor, Tensor, Tensor]:
    """Return differentiable mean, raw second moment and population covariance."""
    _check_history(features, old_mean, old_second, beta)
    batch_mean, batch_second = batch_moments(features)
    mean = beta * old_mean.detach() + (1 - beta) * batch_mean
    second = beta * old_second.detach() + (1 - beta) * batch_second
    covariance = second - torch.outer(mean, mean)
    return mean, second, covariance
problems.notes:
# 参考说明

原始二阶矩同时包含组内方差和组间均值变化。更新后的协方差也可以写成

$$
\Sigma=\beta\Sigma_{old}+(1-\beta)\Sigma_b+
\beta(1-\beta)(\mu_{old}-\mu_b)(\mu_{old}-\mu_b)^\top.
$$

直接平均协方差会丢失最后的外积项。T1 的独立答案给旧样本和当前样本分别分配权重，然后对显式总体的中心化外积求和，不照抄被测实现。

对 `mean.sum()+covariance.trace()`，当前第 i 行特征的梯度是 `(1-beta)/B * (1 + 2*(x_i-mean))`。对 `||mean||^2+trace(covariance)`，它简化为 `2*(1-beta)/B*x_i`，因为该目标等于原始二阶矩的迹。Toy 用后者检查当前微批次的计算图。

实现依据是[官方 queue.py，提交 5c03b811](https://github.com/Jiawei-Yang/FD-Loss/blob/5c03b8112fec8b9432631e4ce053c0d918cc24bc/frechet_distance/queue.py) 中的 `_build_feats_stats_ema`，以及论文 Algorithm 1、Eq.(3)-(5)。官方实现用 float64 计算统计量；本 CPU 题保留调用方的 float32/float64 类型。函数额外返回原始二阶矩，方便脚手架显式 detach 并保存。题目不包含特征队列、原地模块状态、多设备收集或图像骨干网络。

官方队列分支覆盖最旧特征，中心化平方和除以 `N-1`；EMA 分支混合已经归一化的原始矩，重建总体协方差时没有 Bessel 因子。历史已经暖启动，不需要从零初始化 EMA 的偏差修正。

Toy 的已知总体暖启动是受控设计，用于展示历史信息如何影响统计量与梯度。它不验证生成器收敛、不选择论文生产配置的 decay，也不复现 ImageNet 消融。四个错误变体分别覆盖中心化二阶矩、调换 EMA 权重、历史梯度泄漏和用当前批次均值中心化混合二阶矩。

en.title: FD-loss Population Moments and EMA
en.readme:
# FD-loss Population Moments and EMA

Implement the population estimator in [Representation Fréchet Loss for Visual Generation, Section 3.2](https://arxiv.org/html/2604.28190). FD-loss estimates a feature distribution using more history than the current gradient batch. The default EMA variant stores a mean and a **raw second moment**, with gradients flowing through current features only.

For current features $X\in\mathbb R^{B\times D}$, compute

$$
\mu_b=\frac1B\sum_i x_i,\qquad M_b=\frac1B\sum_i x_i x_i^\top.
$$

Then apply Eqs. (4)-(5):

$$
\mu=\beta\,\operatorname{sg}(\mu_{old})+(1-\beta)\mu_b,\quad
M=\beta\,\operatorname{sg}(M_{old})+(1-\beta)M_b,\quad
\Sigma=M-\mu\mu^\top.
$$

## Implement

| Function | Output |
|---|---|
| `batch_moments(features)` | `(mean, raw_second)`, shapes `(D,)`, `(D,D)` |
| `ema_population_stats(features, old_mean, old_second, beta)` | `(mean, raw_second, covariance)`, in that order |

Inputs use the same float32/float64 dtype and device. `B>=1`, `D>=1`, and `beta` lies in `[0,1]`; endpoint values are included for testing. History contains valid finite population moments. Supplied validators cover shapes, dtypes and finite values. Preserve input values and do not update history in place.

Use division by **B**, including when `B=1`. `raw_second` is `E[xx^T]`, not a centered covariance. Detach both historical tensors inside `ema_population_stats`, even when they require gradients. Keep all returned statistics differentiable through the current batch. The caller saves `mean.detach()` and `raw_second.detach()` as the next history; the training loop supplies this state management.

For example, one current feature `[3]`, historical mean `[1]` and raw second moment `[[2]]`, with `beta=.5`, produce mean `[2]`, raw second `[[5.5]]`, and covariance `[[1.5]]`. Simply averaging the old and current covariances would incorrectly give `[[.5]]`.

This exercise implements the paper's **EMA population convention**. The official FIFO queue branch estimates a sample covariance using `N-1`; that distinct estimator is outside this module. No Bessel correction belongs in the EMA equations.

## Toy: population statistics from tiny batches

**Teaching adaptation.** Two shifted 2D components contain eight feature points in total. Forty microbatches alternate between the components, so each batch poorly represents the whole population. Supplied scaffolding warm-starts EMA from those eight points, then calls your functions to compare batch-only and EMA estimation errors. Charts show the estimated mean, variance, and combined moment error. This controlled stream is not an original paper figure or a guarantee about changing real-world distributions.

The paper warm-starts its estimator from a base generator before post-training. This toy supplies features directly to isolate the estimator. Fréchet loss, image encoders, multi-device gathering and generator optimization are outside this exercise.

T0 checks contracts; T1 uses scalar raw moments and an explicitly weighted population; T2 verifies stopped history, analytic current gradients, decay endpoints, affine transformations and multi-step geometric weights. T3 runs your submitted functions over the feature stream. Preview charts use the reference implementation.
en.notes:
# Reference notes

Raw second moments carry both within-component variance and between-component mean variation. Equivalently, the updated covariance is

$$
\Sigma=\beta\Sigma_{old}+(1-\beta)\Sigma_b+
\beta(1-\beta)(\mu_{old}-\mu_b)(\mu_{old}-\mu_b)^\top.
$$

The final outer product is lost when covariances are averaged directly. The independent T1 oracle constructs sample weights for an explicit old/current population and sums centered outer products, rather than copying the implementation.

For `mean.sum()+covariance.trace()`, the gradient at current row `x_i` is `(1-beta)/B * (1 + 2*(x_i-mean))`. For `||mean||^2+trace(covariance)`, it simplifies to `2*(1-beta)/B*x_i`, since the objective equals the trace of the raw second moment. The latter verifies the toy's current-batch graph.

The source boundary is [official queue.py at 5c03b811](https://github.com/Jiawei-Yang/FD-Loss/blob/5c03b8112fec8b9432631e4ce053c0d918cc24bc/frechet_distance/queue.py), especially `_build_feats_stats_ema`, plus Algorithm 1 and Eqs. (3)-(5). Official implementation computes statistics in float64; this CPU exercise preserves the caller's float32/float64 dtype. Its functional return includes the raw second moment so the supplied loop can detach and persist it explicitly. There is no feature queue, in-place module state, distributed gather or image backbone in this exercise.

The official queue path replaces the oldest features and divides centered squared sums by `N-1`. EMA instead mixes normalized raw moments and reconstructs population covariance without a Bessel factor. Warm-started history is supplied; bias correction from zero-initialized EMA is neither required nor introduced.

The toy's full-population warm start is deliberately controlled. It demonstrates why information from previous batches changes estimates and gradients. It does not test generator convergence, choose the paper's production decay, or reproduce its ImageNet ablation. Four mutants target centered second moments, swapped EMA decay, gradients into history, and centering the mixed second moment around the current batch mean.

problems.readme:
# FD-loss 可微 Fréchet 损失

实现 [Representation Fréchet Loss for Visual Generation](https://arxiv.org/html/2604.28190) 的训练目标，对生成总体统计求梯度，并冻结真实参考统计。特征高斯分布的 Eq.(2) 为

$$
FD=\|\mu_g-\mu_r\|_2^2+\operatorname{tr}(\Sigma_g)+\operatorname{tr}(\Sigma_r)
-2\operatorname{tr}\left[(\Sigma_r^{1/2}\Sigma_g\Sigma_r^{1/2})^{1/2}\right].
$$

对称夹积的平方根迹与原始协方差乘积公式一致。附录 B.3 用 `torch.linalg.eigvalsh` 求它的特征值，避免通过生成统计的特征向量反向传播。两个协方差通常**不可交换**。

对于每个表征的距离 `d_i`，Eq.(6) 使用

$$
\mathcal L=\sum_i w_i\frac{d_i}{\operatorname{sg}(d_i)+\epsilon}.
$$

## 需要实现

| 函数 | 输入 | 输出 |
|---|---|---|
| `frechet_distance(mean, covariance, reference_mean, reference_covariance)` | `(D,)` 均值与 `(D,D)` 协方差 | 标量 FD |
| `normalized_fd_loss(distances, weights, eps=.01)` | 相同形状的非空 `(R,)` 向量与有限正 epsilon | 加权归一化距离之**和** |

所有张量的类型和设备相同，使用 float32 或 float64。参数检查已经提供，保留类型和输入数值。在函数内部对真实均值、真实协方差和表征权重停止梯度。生成均值、生成协方差以及距离分子必须保留梯度。

通过**已 detach 的**参考协方差的特征分解构造参考平方根。计算夹积，使用 `(A+A.T)/2` 对称化，再把其特征值开方求和。开方前将数值误差造成的负特征值夹到零。不要添加对角 jitter、逐元素开方、裁剪最终 FD，或对非对称的协方差乘积直接调用 `eigvalsh`。

前向测试支持半正定协方差，包括零特征值。**梯度保证要求生成与参考两个协方差均为正定**，其中也包含重复正特征值的情况。零特征值处的平方根导数不在本题承诺范围内，不用隐式正则化改变目标。

一维示例：均值为 `1` 和 `0`，方差为 `4` 和 `1`，FD 为 `1+(2-1)^2=2`。将它用权重 `1`、epsilon `.01` 归一化，值为 `2/2.01`，但对这个距离的导数是 **`1/2.01`**，因为分母停止梯度。允许 FD 的微小负舍入误差，只要求 `distance+eps` 仍为正；函数不会偷偷裁剪距离。

官方默认使用相同权重和 `.01` 的 epsilon。这个接口也接受其他固定非负权重与有限正 epsilon，不额外除以表征数或权重和。多个冻结特征模型、真实统计和图像编码器属于已提供的上下文，不是本题需要训练的函数。

## Toy：二维生成器后训练

**来源：教学改编。** 一个五参数仿射生成器变换四个对称噪声点。脚手架提供 EMA 总体矩（`beta=.8`），你的 FD 和归一化函数使生成器经过 200 步训练拟合一个相关高斯分布。本实验只用 CPU 张量，采用 `.1` 的 epsilon 和小型 Adam 优化器，不复现 ImageNet 生成器或论文生产超参数。

图表分开展示原始 EMA FD、独立二维公式计算的当前生成器 FD，以及归一化训练目标。归一化值接近一时，原始距离仍可能明显变化，因此用**原始 FD**判断分布拟合进展，不要只看接近一的目标值。

T0 检查接口；T1 使用对角和不可交换二维协方差的闭式答案；T2 检查梯度、冻结参考、重复正谱、停止归一化分母梯度、对称性与坐标变换；T3 真正调用提交函数训练生成器。预览图使用参考实现。
problems.notes:
# 参考说明

二维正定矩阵有一个独立恒等式：

$$
\operatorname{tr}\sqrt{\Sigma_r\Sigma_g}=
\sqrt{\operatorname{tr}(\Sigma_r\Sigma_g)+2\sqrt{\det\Sigma_r\det\Sigma_g}}.
$$

测试对这个标量公式求导，不依赖提交中的特征值算法。不可交换的协方差可以区分正确对称夹积与直接对 `Sigma_r @ Sigma_g` 使用 Hermitian 求解器的错误。坐标变换和对称性测试也会暴露丢失非对角项的问题。测试刻意包含重复正特征值：平方根特征值之和在正定矩阵上仍可微，但对特征向量反向传播的实现可能不稳定。

参考统计是常量。对其 detach 后使用 `eigh` 构造平方根，不需要通过这些特征向量求梯度。生成统计只进入夹积和 `eigvalsh`。半正定矩阵含零特征值时，前向公式仍成立，但平方根导数可能不存在或不有限；因此本题的梯度约定要求两个协方差都正定。不通过给特征值加 epsilon 或裁剪最终 FD 换成另一个目标。

停止分母梯度后的导数是 `w/(distance+eps)`。若对整个数值比值求导，得到的是 `w*eps/(distance+eps)^2`。因此同时改变分子分母的朴素有限差分会验证错误的函数。测试使用解析梯度；如果自行做有限差分，需要把分母固定在原始值。

源实现为[提交 5c03b811 的 losses.py](https://github.com/Jiawei-Yang/FD-Loss/blob/5c03b8112fec8b9432631e4ce053c0d918cc24bc/frechet_distance/losses.py) 中的 `precompute_sigma_ref_sqrt`、`_compute_trace_term`、`compute_frechet_distance_loss`；归一化位于 [main_fd.py](https://github.com/Jiawei-Yang/FD-Loss/blob/5c03b8112fec8b9432631e4ce053c0d918cc24bc/main_fd.py)。教学接口保留 float32/float64，不把最终标量强制转换为 float32。每次调用重新计算小型冻结参考平方根；生产代码会预计算它。多设备收集、非有限值回退、预训练特征网络和采样不在本题范围内。

教学实验使用对称求积点表达小型仿射高斯的精确矩，脚手架提供已停止梯度的 EMA 历史。独立评估器使用上面的二维公式，优化过程调用提交函数。实验同时记录原始和归一化目标，因为接近一的归一化值不能直接反映距离缩减。这些参数与有限生成器是教学选择，不是论文视觉生成基准。

错误变体分别忽略生成相关性、给 `eigvalsh` 非对称输入、对归一化分母求梯度，以及泄漏真实参考统计梯度。

en.title: FD-loss Differentiable Fréchet Objective
en.readme:
# FD-loss Differentiable Fréchet Objective

Implement the training objective in [Representation Fréchet Loss for Visual Generation](https://arxiv.org/html/2604.28190), using generated population statistics and frozen reference statistics. For feature Gaussians, Eq. (2) is

$$
FD=\|\mu_g-\mu_r\|_2^2+\operatorname{tr}(\Sigma_g)+\operatorname{tr}(\Sigma_r)
-2\operatorname{tr}\left[(\Sigma_r^{1/2}\Sigma_g\Sigma_r^{1/2})^{1/2}\right].
$$

The symmetric sandwich has the trace-square-root required by the original covariance-product formula. Appendix B.3 computes its eigenvalues with `torch.linalg.eigvalsh`, avoiding eigenvector differentiation through generated statistics. Covariance matrices generally do **not** commute.

For representation distances `d_i`, Eq. (6) uses

$$
\mathcal L=\sum_i w_i\frac{d_i}{\operatorname{sg}(d_i)+\epsilon}.
$$

## Implement

| Function | Inputs | Output |
|---|---|---|
| `frechet_distance(mean, covariance, reference_mean, reference_covariance)` | `(D,)` means and `(D,D)` covariances | Scalar FD |
| `normalized_fd_loss(distances, weights, eps=.01)` | Matching nonempty `(R,)` vectors and positive finite epsilon | Weighted **sum** of normalized distances |

All tensors share dtype/device, using float32 or float64. Validators are provided. Preserve dtype and input values. Inside the functions, detach reference mean, reference covariance and representation weights. Generated mean/covariance and the distance numerators must keep their gradients.

Use an eigendecomposition of the **detached** reference covariance to build its square root. Form the sandwich, symmetrize it as `(A+A.T)/2`, then sum the square roots of its eigenvalues. Clamp numerical negative eigenvalues to zero before taking their square roots. Do not add diagonal jitter, take an elementwise matrix square root, clip the final FD, or pass a nonsymmetric covariance product to `eigvalsh`.

Forward tests cover positive semidefinite covariances, including zero eigenvalues. **Gradient guarantees require both generated and reference covariances to be positive definite**, including cases with repeated positive eigenvalues. The derivative at a zero eigenvalue is outside this exercise; no hidden regularization changes the objective.

For 1D means `1` and `0` with variances `4` and `1`, FD is `1+(2-1)^2=2`. Normalizing one such distance with weight `1` and epsilon `.01` returns `2/2.01`, but its derivative with respect to that distance is **`1/2.01`**. The denominator is stopped. Tiny negative FD roundoff is accepted as long as `distance+eps` stays positive; distances are not silently clamped.

The official default uses equal weights and epsilon `.01`. This interface also accepts other fixed nonnegative weights and positive epsilons. It does not divide by the number or sum of weights. Multiple frozen feature models, their statistics and image encoders are supplied context, not functions to train here.

## Toy: post-train a 2D generator

**Teaching adaptation.** A five-parameter affine generator transforms four symmetric noise points. Supplied EMA moments (`beta=.8`) feed your FD and normalization functions, which train the generator for 200 steps toward a correlated reference Gaussian. This uses CPU tensors, epsilon `.1` and a small Adam optimizer; it does not reproduce an ImageNet generator or the paper's production hyperparameters.

Charts separately show raw EMA FD, current-generator FD from an independent 2D oracle, and the normalized training objective. The normalized value can stay close to one while raw distance changes substantially, so judge matching progress using **raw FD**, not the near-unit value alone.

T0 checks contracts; T1 uses diagonal and noncommuting 2D closed forms; T2 checks gradients, frozen references, repeated positive spectra, stopped normalization, symmetry and coordinate changes. T3 actually trains with your submitted functions. Preview charts use the reference solution.
en.notes:
# Reference notes

For two-dimensional SPD matrices, an independent identity is

$$
\operatorname{tr}\sqrt{\Sigma_r\Sigma_g}=
\sqrt{\operatorname{tr}(\Sigma_r\Sigma_g)+2\sqrt{\det\Sigma_r\det\Sigma_g}}.
$$

The test oracle differentiates this scalar formula, avoiding the submitted eigenvalue implementation. Noncommuting covariances distinguish the symmetric sandwich from directly applying a Hermitian solver to `Sigma_r @ Sigma_g`. Coordinate-transform and symmetry checks further expose lost off-diagonal terms. Repeated positive eigenvalues are intentional: the sum of square-root eigenvalues remains differentiable on SPD matrices, even when an implementation based on differentiating eigenvectors would become unstable.

Reference statistics are constants. Their square root uses `eigh` after detaching, so no gradient through those eigenvectors is needed. Generated statistics enter only the sandwich and `eigvalsh`. For PSD matrices containing zero eigenvalues, the forward formula still applies, but square-root derivatives may be undefined or nonfinite. Both covariances must be SPD for this module's gradient contract. We do not add epsilon to covariance eigenvalues or clamp the final FD to manufacture a different differentiable objective.

Stopped normalization has gradient `w/(distance+eps)`. Differentiating the full numeric ratio would instead produce `w*eps/(distance+eps)^2`. A naive finite-difference check of changing numerator and denominator would therefore test the wrong function. Tests use an analytic gradient oracle; any finite-difference implementation must freeze the denominator at its base value.

Source implementation: [losses.py at 5c03b811](https://github.com/Jiawei-Yang/FD-Loss/blob/5c03b8112fec8b9432631e4ce053c0d918cc24bc/frechet_distance/losses.py), `precompute_sigma_ref_sqrt`, `_compute_trace_term` and `compute_frechet_distance_loss`; normalization is in [main_fd.py](https://github.com/Jiawei-Yang/FD-Loss/blob/5c03b8112fec8b9432631e4ce053c0d918cc24bc/main_fd.py). The teaching interface preserves float32/float64 rather than forcing the final scalar to float32. It computes the small frozen reference root per call; production code precomputes it. Distributed collection, nonfinite-failure fallbacks, pretrained feature models and sampling are excluded.

The teaching experiment represents a small affine Gaussian by its exact moments using symmetric quadrature points, with supplied detached EMA history. Its independent evaluator uses the 2D identity above; the optimization path calls the submitted functions. It reports both raw and normalized objectives because near-unit normalization values do not directly reveal distance reduction. Its settings and finite generator are teaching choices, not the paper's visual-generation benchmark.

Mutants remove generated correlations, use a nonsymmetric input to `eigvalsh`, differentiate the normalization denominator, or allow reference-statistic gradients.

provenance.adaptation: A five-parameter affine generator uses four symmetric noise points, supplied EMA moments (beta=.8), and submitted differentiable FD and normalization. The reference covariance is correlated. This is a CPU teaching experiment, not image generation; eps=.1 and the optimizer are teaching settings.

problems.readme:
# VICReg 方差、不变性与协方差

实现 [VICReg](https://arxiv.org/html/2105.04906v3) 的特征空间目标：同一样本的两个增强视图保持一致，每个特征在样本之间保留足够变化，不同特征减少冗余。

给定成对特征 $X,Y\in\mathbb R^{B\times D}$，令 $X_c=X-\operatorname{mean}_B(X)$，$C_X=X_c^TX_c/(B-1)$；对 $Y$ 同理。

$$
s=\operatorname{mean}((X-Y)^2),\qquad
v=\frac{1}{2D}\sum_j\left[\max(0,1-\sqrt{C_{X,jj}+\epsilon})+\max(0,1-\sqrt{C_{Y,jj}+\epsilon})\right],
$$

$$
c=\frac1D\sum_{i\ne j}(C_{X,ij}^2+C_{Y,ij}^2),\qquad
L=\lambda s+\mu v+\nu c.
$$

## 需要实现

| 函数 | 输出 |
|---|---|
| `vicreg_terms(x,y,eps=1e-4)` | 三个标量张量，顺序为不变性、方差、协方差 |
| `vicreg_loss(x,y,sim_coeff=25.,std_coeff=25.,cov_coeff=1.,eps=1e-4)` | 加权标量损失 |

两个输入具有相同的 float32/float64 类型、设备和 `(B,D)` 形状，`B>=2`、`D>=1`。输入检查已提供；保持输入内容、类型和设备，两个视图都要有梯度。系数是非负有限 Python 数值；epsilon 有限且大于零。

方差和协方差采用**样本统计**，分母为 `B-1`。不变性对全部 `B*D` 元素取平均；方差项对两个视图取平均；协方差项则对两个视图**求和**。非对角线平方和除以 `D`，不除以特征对数；`(i,j)` 和 `(j,i)` 都计入。`D=1` 时协方差项为零。

上述系数遵循已固定版本的官方代码。代码的 MSE 同时对样本和特征取平均，论文式 (5) 则写为向量距离平方对样本取平均。论文书面总目标对两视图的方差项求和，代码采用平均。本题统一使用代码中的二分之一因子和默认权重。

默认 epsilon 下，两个全零视图的三个损失为 `(0,0.99,0)`，但梯度仍为零。正的塌缩惩罚不代表优化一定能逃离精确塌缩；小幅度但**不恒定**的特征则不同。

## Toy：特征展开与去冗余

**教学改编。** 从小幅、相关但不恒定的 16 对二维特征出发，调用你的函数进行优化。图表展示损失，以及独立计算的标准差和非对角协方差；最后与精确塌缩的三个损失项比较。这里不训练图像编码器。

T0 检查接口；T1 用标量循环和单特征例子检查数值；T2 检查双视图梯度、精确塌缩驻点、平移与置换，以及重复特征的冗余；T3 使用你提交的损失优化特征几何。预览图由参考解生成。
problems.solution:
"""VICReg's three losses, using the official single-process normalization."""
import math
import torch
from torch import Tensor


def _check_pair(x, y, eps):
    if x.ndim != 2 or x.shape[0] < 2 or x.shape[1] < 1 or x.dtype not in (torch.float32, torch.float64):
        raise ValueError("x must be float32/float64 (B,D), B>=2, D>=1")
    if y.shape != x.shape or y.dtype != x.dtype or y.device != x.device:
        raise ValueError("x and y must have the same shape, dtype and device")
    if not torch.isfinite(x).all() or not torch.isfinite(y).all():
        raise ValueError("views must be finite")
    if not math.isfinite(eps) or eps <= 0:
        raise ValueError("eps must be finite and positive")


def _check_weights(sim_coeff, std_coeff, cov_coeff):
    if any(not math.isfinite(v) or v < 0 for v in (sim_coeff, std_coeff, cov_coeff)):
        raise ValueError("coefficients must be finite and nonnegative")


def vicreg_terms(x: Tensor, y: Tensor, eps: float = 1e-4) -> tuple[Tensor, Tensor, Tensor]:
    """Return scalar invariance, variance and covariance terms, in that order."""
    _check_pair(x, y, eps)
    invariance = (x - y).square().mean()
    xc, yc = x - x.mean(0), y - y.mean(0)
    std_x = (xc.square().sum(0) / (x.shape[0] - 1) + eps).sqrt()
    std_y = (yc.square().sum(0) / (y.shape[0] - 1) + eps).sqrt()
    variance = ((1 - std_x).relu().mean() + (1 - std_y).relu().mean()) / 2
    cov_x, cov_y = xc.T @ xc / (x.shape[0] - 1), yc.T @ yc / (y.shape[0] - 1)
    off_diagonal = ~torch.eye(x.shape[1], dtype=torch.bool, device=x.device)
    covariance = (cov_x[off_diagonal].square().sum() + cov_y[off_diagonal].square().sum()) / x.shape[1]
    return invariance, variance, covariance


def vicreg_loss(x: Tensor, y: Tensor, sim_coeff: float = 25., std_coeff: float = 25.,
                cov_coeff: float = 1., eps: float = 1e-4) -> Tensor:
    """Keep gradients in both views and combine the three scalar terms."""
    _check_weights(sim_coeff, std_coeff, cov_coeff)
    invariance, variance, covariance = vicreg_terms(x, y, eps)
    return sim_coeff * invariance + std_coeff * variance + cov_coeff * covariance
problems.notes:
# 参考讲解

沿 batch 维中心化。计算不变性时保留原来的成对特征，因此单独平移一个视图会产生对齐代价；先分别中心化再计算 MSE 会改变目标。

方差 hinge 只要求标准差达到下界，不要求方差精确等于一。若惩罚协方差的全部元素，对角线也会被推向零，与方差下界冲突。两列完全重复的特征可以同时满足标准差下界，却仍有很大的非对角协方差。

当某一维的方差 hinge 激活时，一个视图的导数为

$$
\frac{\partial v}{\partial X_{ij}}=-\frac{X_{ij}-\bar X_j}{2D(B-1)\sqrt{C_{X,jj}+\epsilon}}.
$$

因此，精确恒定的特征即使具有正损失，也有零梯度。T2 同时检查这个驻点和附近不恒定的扰动；toy 从后者这种几何出发。

论文定位为 [v3 第 4.1 节，式 (1)-(6)](https://arxiv.org/html/2105.04906v3)。式 (5) 的向量平方范数对特征求和，官方 MSE 则对特征取平均。本题遵循 [官方 `main_vicreg.py` 的固定版本 4e12602f](https://github.com/facebookresearch/vicreg/blob/4e12602fd495af83efd1631fbe82523e6db092e0/main_vicreg.py) 中的 `VICReg.forward`。分布式聚合后的全局 batch 简化为一个已提供的 batch。论文展示的总目标对两视图方差项求和，官方 `std_loss` 对它们取平均，而 `cov_loss` 求和；权重与这些因子必须对应。

标量循环 oracle 独立计算中心化乘积，梯度检查覆盖两个视图，toy 则独立测量特征几何。四个错误版本分别针对总体统计替代样本统计、方差视图错误求和、惩罚协方差对角线，以及意外 detach 第二个视图。这个 toy 是受控的特征优化，不是论文 ImageNet 实验复现，也不承诺从任意塌缩状态恢复。

en.title: VICReg Variance, Invariance and Covariance
en.readme:
# VICReg Variance, Invariance and Covariance

Implement the feature-space objective from [VICReg](https://arxiv.org/html/2105.04906v3). Two augmented views should agree, each feature should retain sufficient spread across examples, and different features should avoid redundant covariance.

Given paired features $X,Y\in\mathbb R^{B\times D}$, let $X_c=X-\operatorname{mean}_B(X)$ and $C_X=X_c^TX_c/(B-1)$, with the same definitions for $Y$.

$$
s=\operatorname{mean}((X-Y)^2),\qquad
v=\frac{1}{2D}\sum_j\left[\max(0,1-\sqrt{C_{X,jj}+\epsilon})+\max(0,1-\sqrt{C_{Y,jj}+\epsilon})\right],
$$

$$
c=\frac1D\sum_{i\ne j}(C_{X,ij}^2+C_{Y,ij}^2),\qquad
L=\lambda s+\mu v+\nu c.
$$

## Implement

| Function | Output |
|---|---|
| `vicreg_terms(x,y,eps=1e-4)` | Three scalar tensors `(invariance, variance, covariance)` |
| `vicreg_loss(x,y,sim_coeff=25.,std_coeff=25.,cov_coeff=1.,eps=1e-4)` | Weighted scalar loss |

Both inputs have matching float32/float64 dtype, device and `(B,D)` shape, with `B>=2` and `D>=1`. Supplied validators check the contract. Preserve inputs and dtype/device. Both views receive gradients. Coefficients are finite nonnegative Python numbers; epsilon is finite and positive.

Use **sample** variance and covariance with denominator `B-1`. Invariance averages all `B*D` entries. Variance averages the two view penalties, while covariance **sums** them. Divide the off-diagonal squared sum by `D`, not by the number of pairs. Both `(i,j)` and `(j,i)` count. When `D=1`, covariance loss is zero.

These normalizations follow the pinned official code. Its MSE averages over features as well as samples, whereas the paper's Eq. (5) writes a sample mean of squared vector norms. The paper's written combined objective sums its per-view variance terms; the code averages them. This exercise uses the code's factor of one half and its default weights consistently.

Identical all-zero embeddings yield `(0,0.99,0)` at default epsilon. They still have zero gradient: the positive penalty is not a guarantee that optimization can escape exact collapse. A small **nonconstant** feature cloud is a different case.

## Toy: spread and redundancy

**Teaching adaptation.** Optimize two sets of 16 paired 2D embeddings from small, correlated, nonconstant values. The scaffold calls your functions and plots loss, independently measured standard deviation and off-diagonal covariance. Compare the three final terms with exact collapse. No image encoder is trained.

T0 checks the interface. T1 uses a scalar-loop oracle and a one-feature case. T2 checks both-view gradients, the exact-collapse stationary point, translations, permutations and duplicated-feature redundancy. T3 optimizes the supplied geometry using your submitted loss; preview plots use the reference solution.
en.notes:
# Reference notes

Center along the batch axis. The invariance term uses the original paired values, so independently translating one view still incurs an alignment cost. Centering both views before the MSE would change that objective.

The variance hinge only asks that standard deviation reach a floor. It does not force variance to exactly one. In contrast, penalizing every covariance entry would push diagonal variance back toward zero and conflict with that floor. Two duplicated feature columns can each satisfy the floor while their off-diagonal covariance remains large.

For an active variance hinge, the derivative for one view is

$$
\frac{\partial v}{\partial X_{ij}}=-\frac{X_{ij}-\bar X_j}{2D(B-1)\sqrt{C_{X,jj}+\epsilon}}.
$$

This directly explains why exactly constant features have zero gradient despite positive variance loss. T2 checks that stationary point and a nearby nonconstant perturbation; the toy starts from the latter kind of geometry.

The paper anchor is [v3 Section 4.1, Eqs. (1)-(6)](https://arxiv.org/html/2105.04906v3). Eq. (5) sums feature coordinates inside the squared vector norm, whereas official MSE averages those coordinates. The implementation convention comes from [official `main_vicreg.py` at 4e12602f](https://github.com/facebookresearch/vicreg/blob/4e12602fd495af83efd1631fbe82523e6db092e0/main_vicreg.py), `VICReg.forward`. This module replaces the distributed global batch with a single supplied batch. Unlike the displayed paper sum of per-view variance terms, official `std_loss` averages them; official `cov_loss` sums them. Matching the coefficients requires retaining that distinction.

The scalar-loop oracle computes centered products without the reference implementation. Gradient checks cover both views, and the toy independently measures feature geometry. Four mutants target population instead of sample statistics, an incorrect variance-view sum, inclusion of diagonal covariance, and an accidentally detached second view. The toy is a controlled embedding optimization, not a replication of the paper's ImageNet experiments or a claim of universal collapse avoidance.
